{
    "node_name": "Classic Margherita Pizza 02",
    "node_desc": "A simple, authentic Neapolitan-style Margherita pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and a blistered crust.",
    "node_content_md": "# Classic Margherita Pizza

## Ingredients
- 500g strong bread flour
- 325ml warm water
- 10g salt
- 7g instant yeast
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- 200g canned San Marzano tomatoes, crushed
- 250g fresh mozzarella, torn into pieces
- Fresh basil leaves
- Extra virgin olive oil
- Salt to taste

## Makes
- 2 medium pizzas (about 10–12" each)

## Prep & Cook Time
- Prep: 20 minutes (+ 1–24 hr proving)
- Cook: 6–8 minutes (in a very hot oven or pizza stone)

## Directions
1. In a bowl, mix flour and salt. Dissolve yeast in warm water, then combine with flour and olive oil. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
2. Cover and let rise until doubled (1–2 hours) or refrigerate for a slow 24-hour ferment for more flavor.
3. Preheat oven to highest temperature (250–300°C / 475–570°F) with a pizza stone if available.
4. Divide dough into two balls, stretch to disks.
5. Spread a thin layer of crushed tomatoes, season lightly with salt. Top with torn mozzarella.
6. Bake on the stone or hot tray until crust is blistered and cheese melted (6–8 minutes).
7. Finish with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

## Notes
- Use high heat for authentic charring.
- For extra flavor, use a 24-hour cold ferment and very high-protein flour."
}
